summary: 88-key piano: real sound, 128 instruments, recording & MIDI export. Free.
description:
Real Piano Keyboard is a realistic, full 88-key piano for your phone or tablet — completely free and ad-free.

Play with authentic recorded piano sound and true multi-touch, so chords and fast runs feel natural. Press toward the front of a key to play louder with touch velocity (optional), and hold notes with the sustain pedal. Prefer real keys? Connect an external MIDI keyboard over USB or Bluetooth and play through the app. Read the keys in the notation you prefer — English, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Indian or Cyrillic — with optional octave numbers, and zoom from a few large keys to the full keyboard.

NEW — 128 instruments:
• The grand piano is studio-recorded and always free.
• Unlock Premium once to play 128 more instruments — electric pianos, organs, guitars, strings, synths and more.

Recording & export:
• Record your performance and play it back instantly — free.
• With Premium, save your takes and export them as audio (.m4a) or a Standard MIDI File (.mid), on any instrument — ready to share or open in any notation app.

Whether you're a beginner finding your first melody or a musician sketching an idea, Real Piano Keyboard has something for you. Start discovering your musical potential today.
